title: Senior Technical Pre Sales Analyst
description:
At EBANX, we believe barriers were made to be broken. We started our story in Curitiba, Brazil, and today we are a global company, present in more 29 countries, with offices in Curitiba, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Johannesburg. In total, we are 700+ ebankers spread across the world, connecting companies like Uber, Netflix, Spotify, TikTok, Canva, Shopee, Meta, and Shein to millions of consumers in emerging markets—creating new opportunities and revolutionizing the future of digital payments.

Our mission is clear: to give global access to everyone. We are guided by the motto #TamoJunto, which translates into four key pillars: Shape Tomorrow, Evolve Fast, Make It Happen, and Unlock The World.

If you want to be part of a global company with accelerated growth that is shaping the future of digital payments, EBANX is the place for you.

In the Operations team at EBANX, you don’t just oversee processes. You ensure that every step of our solution runs accurately, efficiently, and reliably, impacting millions of transactions worldwide. Here, operational excellence combines with innovation and collaboration to make our work truly Out Of The Ordinary.

What your day-to-day will look like

  • Work closely with the Commercial Team to understand the customer needs and define the best technical solution.
  • Lead technical calls with different types of audiences: presenting EBANX solutions and/or exploratory discovery meetings to understand the customer's business case.
  • Work with Internal Teams (Business Architecture, Product, Regulatory, Finance, Dev) to design and validate the customer business case and needs, always seeking the best solution.
  • Prioritize, communicate, and mitigate issues and risks with internal stakeholders promptly.
  • Prepare a high-quality, documented solution proposal that is going to be delivered to the customer and used by EBANX Internal Teams as a guide to the Implementation Project.
  • Report to internal stakeholders weekly on the progress of all of your work with the customers.
  • Guarantee a frictionless handover to the implementation team once the design is complete.

What you need to shine in this role

  • Technical background, with a focus on Web-based/cloud applications, and API communication.
  • Payments industry background.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with people across geographically diverse cultures.
  • Customer-facing skills, effective interpersonal relationships, demonstrating professional and technical credibility.
  • A strong Team Player, helping to develop the Pre-Sales Engineer Team alongside the EBANX Growth.
  • Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent in a tech area.

Bonus points if you have

  • Spanish is a plus.

EBANX offers

  • Performance Bonus: Annual bonus program based on company results.
  • Meal Allowance: Monthly allowance to support your meals.
  • EBANX Education: Financial assistance for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs to support your professional growth.
  • EBANX Skills: Dedicated budget for courses, certifications, and workshops to encourage continuous learning.
  • Language Classes: Language classes to support your personal and professional development.
  • Health & Well-being: Medical and dental plans with extensive coverage, including support for dependents and wellness programs.
  • Flexible Work Culture: Semi-flexible hours, additional day off on your birthday, and year-end break to support work-life balance.
  • Well-being Program: Access to activities and resources that promote physical and mental health.

We believe it is possible to create a diverse, equal and inclusive environment.

This position is highly data‑driven and supports the FIU by conducting AML‑related activities through advanced data extraction, manipulation, and analysis as part of the transaction monitoring and investigation lifecycle.

Role

Personal Attributes

  • Ability to proactively manage time and prioritize assignments to meet target dates and deadlines, while delivering thorough, accurate and quality work product.

  • Ability to work independently, thrive in fast‑paced and dynamic environment, and consistently meet established deadlines.
  • Ability to clearly explain and defend analytical conclusions verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to remain flexible in a demanding work environment while adapting rapidly changing priorities.
  • Availability to work in a hybrid model, with a requirement to be in the office 3 times per week.

Corporate Security Responsibility

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices.

title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.

This is a fully remote role.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.
  • Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.
  • Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.
  • Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.
  • Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.
  • Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.
  • Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.
  • Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine).

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.
  • Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.
  • AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.
  • Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.
  • Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

Bonus

  • Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.
  • Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).
  • Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.
  • Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.

Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances.
  • Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1.
  • Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions.
  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities.
  • An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
  • Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.
  • Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

title: AUXILIAR DE LABORATORIO - TRIAGEM E SOROTECA (APOIOLAB - COTIA)
description:
Auxiliar nas atividades pré-analíticas do laboratório, garantindo a correta triagem, identificação, preparo, armazenamento e conservação de amostras biológicas, assegurando a rastreabilidade, integridade e qualidade das amostras destinadas às análises clínicas e à soroteca.

Triagem de Amostras

  • Receber, conferir e identificar amostras biológicas (sangue, soro, plasma, urina, fezes e outros materiais).
  • Verificar conformidade das amostras com requisições médicas e critérios de aceitação (volume, identificação, acondicionamento e prazo).
  • Registrar amostras em sistema informatizado e/ou controles internos.
  • Organizar e encaminhar amostras para os setores técnicos correspondentes.
  • Comunicar não conformidades à equipe técnica ou à coordenação.

Soroteca

  • Realizar separação e aliquotagem de amostras de soro e plasma.
  • Identificar, rastrear e armazenar amostras conforme protocolos estabelecidos.
  • Organizar freezers, geladeiras e crioboxes da soroteca.
  • Controlar temperatura e registrar monitoramentos conforme normas de qualidade.
  • Auxiliar na localização, retirada e descarte de amostras conforme prazos definidos.
  • Garantir o correto descarte de amostras conforme normas de biossegurança.

Rotinas Gerais

  • Cumprir normas de biossegurança, uso de EPIs e boas práticas laboratoriais.
  • Auxiliar na limpeza, organização e conservação do setor.
  • Seguir PO Ps (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) e instruções da Qualidade.
  • Colaborar em auditorias internas e externas quando solicitado.
  • Apoiar a equipe técnica em atividades correlatas à rotina pré-analítica.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório).
  • Curso de Auxiliar ou Técnico em Análises Clínicas, Patologia Clínica ou áreas correlatas (desejável).

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Noções de triagem de amostras clínicas.
  • Conhecimento básico em biossegurança.
  • Identificação e acondicionamento de materiais biológicos.
  • Organização e rastreabilidade de amostras.
  • Conhecimento básico de informática (sistemas laboratoriais).

Experiência

  • Desejável experiência prévia em laboratório de análises clínicas, especialmente em triagem ou soroteca.

description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

The Finance Director is responsible for the end-to-end financial management of a regulated payment institution operating in Brazil with both traditional banking and digital asset (crypto) activities. The role combines the responsibilities of a CFO within a Banco Central do Brasil regulated payment institution with the operational and financial oversight required for a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP).

The Finance Director will oversee all financial, accounting, treasury, regulatory reporting, and operational finance functions while ensuring strict compliance with Brazilian banking regulations and emerging crypto regulatory frameworks. The role requires a hands‑on and operational leader who is deeply involved in daily financial operations, payment flows, fiat and crypto liquidity management, and the integrity of financial reporting across both traditional and blockchain-based systems.

This position acts as a key member of the executive leadership team, partnering with the local General Manager, regulators, banking partners, and internal operational teams to ensure the institution operates with strong financial discipline, transparency, and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the company’s financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management processes.
  • Oversee controllership, accounting, and financial reporting, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and regulatory standards.
  • Act as the primary financial counterpart for regulators, ensuring compliance with financial and prudential reporting requirements established by the Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) and other applicable authorities.
  • Lead treasury, liquidity management, cash positioning, and banking relationships, ensuring the institution maintains financial resilience and operational stability.
  • Oversee the financial governance of fiat payment operations, including key payment infrastructure such as PIX, bank transfers, payment processors, and banking partners, ensuring appropriate reconciliation control.
  • Oversee financial operations related to digital assets, including wallets, custodial balances, blockchain reconciliations, and crypto treasury activities, ensuring accurate accounting treatment, visibility over on‑chain transactions, and proper integration into financial reporting and internal controls.
  • Monitor capital adequacy, balance sheet efficiency, and financial performance to support both growth and regulatory compliance.
  • Monitor tax compliance and possess strong knowledge of tax legislation to validate tax obligations and support effective tax planning strategies.
  • Strengthen internal controls, financial governance, and audit readiness across the finance function.
  • Partner closely with Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, Product, and Engineering to ensure the company’s growth and innovation agenda is supported by strong financial foundations and sound governance.

Requirements:

  • BA/BS in Finance or Accounting (Master/MBA, CMA or CPA preferred)
  • Extensive experience serving as a CFO, Finance Director, or senior finance executive within a regulated financial institution, fintech, payments company, or digital asset platform. Experience managing finance functions in regulated environments is essential.
  • Expertise in financial reporting under Brazilian accounting standards and IFRS, including experience managing complex financial reporting environments that involve high transaction volumes and multiple asset classes.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks applicable to financial institutions regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil, including regulatory reporting requirements, capital adequacy expectations, and financial governance standards.
  • Understanding of fiat payment systems including bank transfers, payment processors, and domestic payment networks such as PIX, along with the reconciliation and financial reporting requirements associated with these systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in highly operational environments, with a self‑starter mentality and hands‑on involvement in payment flows, treasury movements, transaction reconciliations, and day‑to‑day financial processes.
  • Ability to work in an unstructured environment, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple assignments simultaneously, and provide clarity and structure
  • Fluent writing and speaking in English and Portuguese required

description:
About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Survey Participants

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The role

We are looking for Study Participants from all professional backgrounds across Brazil to take part in academic and applied research studies for global businesses and educational faculties.

Whether you are just starting your career or are a seasoned expert, your perspective is valuable. We are actively seeking a diverse range of educational backgrounds, including:

  • No High School Diploma / High School Graduates
  • Trade School & Vocational Professionals (MBO)
  • Undergraduate & Master's Degree Holders (HBO/WO)
  • PhD Candidates & Doctoral Researchers

If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick 10- to 15-minute screening to assess your suitability. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a participant, where you’ll get paid to contribute to a wide range of projects.

Compensation

Researchers looking for your profile tend to pay up to $18/hr per study completed. While many tasks are short, you should be prepared for studies that require up to one hour of uninterrupted work.

What you’ll be doing in the role

As a participant, you will contribute to high-quality research outcomes by responding thoughtfully to various tasks, including:

  • AI Training & Evaluation: helping refine Large Language Models by ranking responses or providing creative prompts.
  • Behavioral Experiments: participating in decision-making tasks and cognitive games.
  • User Research: providing feedback on new software, apps, or product concepts.
  • Academic Studies: assisting university researchers in fields like psychology, economics, and sociology.
  • Interviews: engaging in one-on-one deep dives regarding your professional expertise or lived experience.
  • Surveys & Questionnaires: sharing your opinions on current events, consumer habits, or workplace culture.

What you’ll bring

  • Diverse Perspective: a track record of relevant experience, knowledge, or lived context (from entry-level roles to executive or academic positions).
  • Attention to Detail: the ability to remain focused and provide high-quality data for the duration of a study.
  • Technical Setup: a reliable, fast internet connection and access to a desktop or laptop computer.
  • Financial Readiness: a PayPal account to receive payments and a willingness to self-declare earnings as a self-employed participant.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We’ve built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won’t come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

O Supervisor de Teste Hidrostático e Gelo Seco é responsável pela liderança e coordenação das atividades técnicas, operacionais e de gestão de qualidade relacionadas aos testes hidrostáticos e à produção de gelo seco. Além disso, o supervisor desempenha um papel crucial na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe, bem como na interação com clientes e autoridades reguladoras.

Formação Educacional: Superior em Engenharia Mecânica.

Experiência Desejada: Experiência de 2 a 3 anos de experiência em funções relacionadas.

Pontos de Atenção: Experiência no uso de software TOTVs será um diferencial.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATIVIDADES

1. Gestão Técnica e Operacional:

· Planejar, coordenar e supervisionar as atividades técnicas do laboratório e da produção de gelo seco.

· Garantir a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão da qualidade em todas as áreas de atuação da empresa.

· Supervisionar a produção de gelo seco, assegurando que os processos atendam aos padrões de qualidade e eficiência.

· Coordenar e supervisionar as manutenções preventivas e corretivas em equipamentos, incluindo os utilizados na produção de gelo seco e ensaios hidrostáticos.

2. Garantia de Qualidade:

· Verificar a conformidade dos ensaios realizados e dos processos de produção de gelo seco com os requisitos normativos e padrões internos.

· Analisar criticamente e aprovar relatórios técnicos e operacionais, assegurando exatidão, clareza e objetividade nos resultados apresentados.

· Implementar controles de qualidade na produção de gelo seco e nos serviços de manutenção, visando a melhoria contínua.

3. Imparcialidade e Confidencialidade:

· Garantir que todas as atividades sejam conduzidas de forma imparcial, preservando a integridade e a credibilidade dos serviços prestados.

· Proteger informações confidenciais dos clientes, bem como dados técnicos gerados durante os processos de ensaio, produção e manutenção.

4. Gerenciamento de Riscos e Não Conformidades:

· Identificar, registrar e mitigar riscos em todas as operações, incluindo a produção de gelo seco e manutenção de equipamentos.

· Avaliar e gerenciar trabalhos não conformes, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas conforme necessário.

5. Capacitação e Desenvolvimento de Equipe:

· Assegurar a formação e competência técnica da equipe envolvida nas atividades de ensaio, produção de gelo seco e manutenção.

· Promover treinamentos internos e externos conforme o plano anual, acompanhando a eficácia e resultados das capacitações.

6. Atividades de Signatário:

· Autorizar formalmente relatórios de ensaio e interpretações técnicas em nome do laboratório.

· Assumir responsabilidade técnica e legal pelos serviços de ensaio, produção e manutenção prestados pela empresa.

6. Interação com Clientes e Autoridades:

· Cooperar com clientes para esclarecer requisitos técnicos, propor soluções e resolver dúvidas sobre ensaios, manutenção fornecimento de gelo seco.

· Representar a empresa perante órgãos reguladores e de acreditação em todos os aspectos técnicos e operacionais.

7. Produção de Gelo Seco e Serviços Associados:

· Supervisionar a fabricação de gelo seco, garantind eficiência, segurança e atendimento aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.

· Desenvolver e implementar melhorias nos processos de produção para otimizar custos e aumentar a capacidade produtiva.

8. Manutenção de Equipamentos e Infraestrutura:

· Coordenar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos utilizados nos ensaios, produção de gelo seco e outras operações técnicas.

· Garantir a disponibilidade e o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos e instalações para minimizar interrupções nas operações.

9. Melhoria Contínua:

· Participar das análises críticas da gestão, avaliando o desempenho das operações e propondo melhorias em todas as áreas de atuação.

· Monitorar e implementar ações corretivas e preventivas, visando à eficiência operacional e à satisfação dos clientes.

10. Liderança e Gestão de Equipe:

· Liderar, treinar e desenvolver uma equipe de técnicos, promovendo práticas seguras e eficazes de trabalho.

· Planejar e distribuir tarefas de acordo com as habilidades e competências dos membros da equipe, assegurando a otimização dos recursos disponíveis.

· Conduzir avaliações de desempenho regulares e fornecer feedback construtivo para o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.

· Facilitar a comunicação eficaz e resolver quaisquer conflitos ou desafios que possam surgir dentro da equipe.

· Criar e manter um ambiente de trabalho positivo, incentivando a colaboração e o engajamento dos funcionários.

11. Autoridade:

· Aprovar métodos e procedimentos de ensaio, produção de gelo seco e manutenção.

· Realizar a análise crítica de pedidos, propostas e contratos técnicos e operacionais.

· Decidir sobre a continuidade ou interrupção de trabalhos em caso de não conformidades ou problemas operacionais.

description:
Analista de Fomento para Projetos de Financiamento de Pesquisa e Inovação

São Paulo - SP

Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.

Sabemos que muitas pessoas — especialmente mulheres — só se candidatam a uma vaga se sentem que cumprem 100% dos requisitos. Se esse for o seu caso, queremos te encorajar a se inscrever mesmo assim. Aqui, valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada.

Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências.

Essa posição está associada à capacidade do Instituto Kunumi de acessar e estruturar recursos de fomento, atuando na interface entre conformidade institucional e execução de projetos, com vistas a apoiar a sustentabilidade do Instituto.

Trata-se de um papel que conecta instrumentos de financiamento à viabilização de iniciativas estratégicas, assegurando que projetos se convertam em entregas consistentes e com impacto no ecossistema de pesquisa e inovação.

Esse propósito se traduz, na prática, nos seguintes Jobs to Be Done:

Estruturar a participação do Instituto em oportunidades de fomento: atuar na identificação, interpretação e articulação de editais, garantindo sua conversão em iniciativas alinhadas à estratégia institucional.

Traduzir exigências de fomento em propostas estruturadas: organizar projetos e parcerias em propostas competitivas e institucionalmente consistentes.

Conduzir a formalização e conformidade de projetos financiados: assegurar a correta aplicação de instrumentos jurídicos e administrativos, garantindo segurança institucional ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto.

Sustentar a execução de projetos com previsibilidade e controle: acompanhar a dimensão administrativa dos projetos, garantindo alinhamento com prazos, regras e exigências dos financiadores.

Assegurar a integridade dos processos de acompanhamento e prestação de contas: estruturar e conduzir relatórios e prestações de contas com qualidade e aderência normativa com atividades como: gestão, monitoramento e controle administrativo, financeiro e contábil de acordo com as regras dos respectivos editais, elaboração de relatórios periódicos, organização de evidências comprobatórias da realização dos projetos (recibos, notas fiscais, fotos, vídeos).

Estruturar fluxos institucionais de fomento: consolidar processos, rotinas e práticas que ampliem a eficiência operacional e a capacidade de escala do Instituto e de seus COLABs.

O que é esperado de você

Vivência prática comprovada em ambientes de fomento à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação.

Domínio na leitura e interpretação de editais, chamadas públicas e legislações correlatas, e capacidade de elaboração de textos complexos de projetos (definição de escopo, justificativa e objetivos).

Experiência na gestão administrativo-financeira de recursos incentivados, públicos e privados, e familiaridade com os fluxos, dinâmicas institucionais e aspectos jurídicos da gestão de projetos financiados.

Alta capacidade de organização, atenção rigorosa a detalhes e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplos cronogramas simultaneamente.

Habilidade de interlocução com diferentes públicos (pesquisadores, jurídico, administrativo e parceiros externos).

  • Inglês fluente e flexibilidade para viagens conforme necessidade dos projetos.

O que é considerado um diferencial

Trajetória prévia em agências de fomento, fundações de apoio ou instituições de fomento à pesquisa.

Vivência em ICTs (Institutos de Ciência e Tecnologia), ambientes de inovação ou projetos colaborativos entre a academia e o setor privado.

Familiaridade prática com as plataformas e normativas de órgãos específicos, como CNPq, FINEP e CAPES.

Compreensão aprofundada sobre a lógica dos instrumentos de financiamento e seus desdobramentos institucionais e conhecimento amplo do ecossistema de inovação, facilitando a leitura de cenários complexos e diversificados.

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes.

Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto.

Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Acreditamos no potencial humano e na capacidade de atuar como catalisadores para um futuro mais equilibrado.

  • Cultura dinâmica, diversa e focada no crescimento conjunto
  • Trabalho em ambiente remoto com horário flexível
  • Suporte home-office (ajuda de custo, cadeira, headphones, laptop, entre outros)
  • Plano de saúde premium e dental para você e seus dependentes, sem mensalidade
  • Alimentação (cartão flexível)
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Assistência a Filhos
  • Auxílio para Filhos(as) com Deficiência
  • Programas de promoção à Saúde - mental, física e emocional
  • Recesso remunerado de final de ano

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

title: Especialista de Business Intelligence
description:
Somos um grande ecossistema de restaurantes que reúne marcas internacionais como Burger King®, Popeyes®, Starbucks® e Subway®.

E, por trás de cada receita de sucesso, estão os Zampers: gente que faz acontecer, que joga junto e que deixa sua marca todos os dias.

Aqui, a gente acredita que o verdadeiro sabor do sucesso é ter espaço pra criar, crescer, liderar e ser quem você é. Usamos tecnologia, inovação e muita parceria para entregar experiências que surpreendem nossos clientes e geram oportunidades para o nosso time. Temos apetite pelo futuro e ousadia para conquistar novos mercados, novos sabores e novas conexões. Porque grandes marcas só existem quando grandes pessoas constroem algo maior do que elas mesmas.

Isso é a Zamp® : um ecossistema de restaurantes e pessoas em constante evolução.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nessa posição, você será responsável por transformar dados em decisões, conduzindo análises profundas de performance de vendas, construindo dashboards executivos e desenvolvendo modelos preditivos que orientam a estratégia de mais de 1.000 restaurantes em todo o Brasil.

Buscamos um(a) profissional analítico(a), com sólida bagagem técnica e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para públicos executivos e operacionais.

Análise de Dados e Performance de Vendas

  • Realizar análises aprofundadas de métricas core do varejo: SSS (Same-Store Sales), SST, AUV, ticket médio, tráfego, conversão e mix de produtos
  • Conduzir análises de decomposição de vendas (tráfego vs. ticket vs. mix; preço vs. volume vs. canal)
  • Identificar outliers de performance entre lojas e regiões e mapear oportunidades de crescimento versus baseline
  • Desenvolver análises de uplift de campanhas e canibalização entre produtos e plataformas de venda

Experimentação e Testes

  • Estruturar e conduzir testes A/B de preço, promoções e bundles, além de pilotos regionais
  • Definir grupos controle vs. tratamento, métricas de sucesso e parâmetros de significância estatística
  • Realizar a leitura e interpretação de resultados com rigor metodológico, garantindo conclusões confiáveis

Forecasting e Modelagem de Demanda

  • Construir e manter modelos de previsão de vendas multi-nível (loja, canal, região e produto)
  • Aplicar modelos de séries temporais (ARIMA, SARIMA, Prophet) e modelos causais com drivers externos
  • Modelar a influência de sazonalidade, calendário, clima, eventos, mídia e promoções sobre a demanda
  • Monitorar a acurácia dos modelos por meio de métricas como MAPE, RMSE e bias, evoluindo para ensemble models

Metas e Planejamento

  • Participar ativamente do processo de montagem e revisão de metas loja a loja, utilizando Python para automação e cálculo
  • Garantir consistência metodológica na definição de alvos de performance ao longo do ano

Visualização e Suporte à Decisão

  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards executivos em Power BI, com foco em performance vs. plano/orçamento e forecast vs. realizado
  • Criar narrativas orientadas à decisão que respondam claramente: o que aconteceu, por que aconteceu e o que fazer a seguir
  • Apresentar análises de forma estruturada para stakeholders de diferentes níveis hierárquicos

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Economia ou áreas correlatas
  • SQL avançado: joins complexos, window functions, CTEs e modelagem de dados
  • Excel avançado: tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas, modelagem analítica
  • Power BI: construção de dashboards, modelagem de dados (DAX), boas práticas de visualização
  • Python intermediário ou avançado: pandas, numpy, statsmodels, scikit-learn
  • Experiência comprovada com modelagem estatística e séries temporais
  • Capacidade analítica sólida e atenção a detalhes

Diferenciais

title: Data Center Mechanical Engineer - LATAM Technology - Infrastructure Sao Paulo Regular
description:
Overview

The Global Data Center Engineering team serves the company global regions with focus on enabling business growth with new data center capacities, doing so with assurance of the data center engineering systems operating continuous stability. Our team is geographically based, with the focus of having local staff to service the local regions. We collaborate with other project teams to select sites, contract sites, designs and build out the new sites. The candidate needs to be familiar with data centre mechanical system engineering designs, building industrial standards and codes, CFD modeling, PUE calculations, systems commissioning, systems availability analysis. Heat transfer and emergency power generation experience are essential for this job.

Responsibilities

  • Participate and review in data center site selection and contractual evaluations, design solutions, and support project executions through construction to final site acceptance.
  • Participate and review Data Center MEP Design and other necessary disciplines for new data center builds and data hall fit outs.
  • Create data hall layout plans and perform test fits to validate server capacity plans and failover calculations.
  • Participate in Testing and Commissioning Discussions to determine required tests to verify design elements.
  • Support the DC Engineering FM team to become a Subject Matter Expert and understand how to overcome design limitations and risks.
  • Conduct a periodic Audit or Assessment to access the effectiveness and practicality of the design in‑use on our data centers.
  • Be our ambassador to explain data center infrastructure design to visitors.
  • Find ways to collaborate and break new ground to enhance MEP design to meet future business needs.
  • Maintain positive and collaborative working relations with partner teams, vendors, teammates, and internal customers.
  • International travel requirement: up to 6 times per year, including but not limited to China, Americas, and South Asia. Candidates must have a valid passport and be able to obtain the necessary visas.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, or relevant disciplines.
  • Knowledge of power and cooling designs, and calculations to determine capacity requirements.
  • Understand Power and Cooling Redundancy and how it is implemented in design (i.e., 2N or N+1 Distributed Redundant, UTI, TIA-942, ASHRAE standards).
  • Experience with Cooling Redundancy and how Concurrent Maintainability is implemented in design (i.e., N+1 or N+2).
  • Experience in the following areas:
    • Lead or influence Engineering Design and Architect teams to complete Data Center Conceptual>30%>60%>90% Detailed Design Process.
    • Practice Data Center Tiering Standards (i.e., TIA-942 Rated 3, or Uptime Tier 3) in a detailed design process.
    • Lead or influence a construction team to complete Data Hall fit‑out experience, including IT services Coordination, Power and Cooling Planning.
    • Lead or influence a testing and commissioning team to perform L1 to L5 commissioning tests to validate the system design intent and resolve technical problems along the way.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 4+ years or more experience in data center engineering.
  • Mechanical and/or electrical engineering experience such as generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, UPS, electrical sub‑distribution systems, etc.
  • Liquid cooling for IT systems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with attention to clarity and detail.

title: Manager, Science and Data for Decision Making
description:
Position Overview

ABOUT RARE AND FISH FOREVER

Rare inspires change so people and nature thrive. Our culture is results-oriented and entrepreneurial, committed to working towards ambitious goals and creating measurable results.

It’s never been a better time to join the Rare team! Rare Brazil is a Brazilian non-profit organization established in the country in 2014 that holds an Affiliate Agreement with Rare Inc. The non-profit organization has worked in 8 Brazilian states: Santa Catarina, Bahia, Ceará, Piaui, Maranhão, Pernambuco, Alagoas, and Pará. In these 8 states, Rare’s behavior adoption campaigns have reached +6,000 small-scale fishers and +12,000 community members from +77 communities in 4 years. In 2019, Rare Brazil concentrated its efforts in the state of Para, reframing the strategic activities, and with the organizational objective to promote, (through a network of local, state, and national partners) the strengthening of governance structures for effective management of coastal fisheries through three interrelated pillars: 1) Establishing and strengthening community-based fisheries management; 2) Supporting access to rights for citizenship by supporting the definition/implementation of public policies and governance aimed at prioritizing access and use of fishing resources by artisanal marine-coastal fishermen; and 3) Enabling financial inclusion and a fair market for artisanal fishers. Due to the quality and breadth of actions needed to be addressed to improve the quality of life of communities and fisheries management, Rare Brazil seeks to engage and legitimize important local actors and strengthen their role in management, and to expand support, capacity, and resources from state and municipal governments directed towards this end. Currently, the organization operates in 12 coastal marine municipalities that are part of Marine Extractive Reserves (Resex), indirectly impacting +28,000 people through the program, including +960 women, and +70 young people.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Manager, Science and Data for Decision Making leads Rare Brazil’s monitoring, evaluation, and program data systems function. This is a strategic management role with primary responsibility for team management, budget oversight, and delivery of high-quality monitoring and reporting outputs .

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Program Implementation , the Manager provides oversight and direction to a team of specialists and consultants, translating Rare’s strategic goals into operational plans aligned with grant requirements, institutional partnerships, and community-level outcomes.

This is a management role focused on people leadership, budget management, operational planning, and quality control of monitoring and data processes . The role supports the broader science and learning agenda of Rare Brasil, while broader institutional strategy, external representation, and highly specialized scientific leadership remain shared with senior leadership and technical partners.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Program and Scope Management (25%)

  • Lead annual and multi-year workplan development for the science and data workstream, ensuring alignment with Rare’s strategic objectives and grant deliverables.
  • Define, monitor, and adjust program scope, milestones, and KPIs in coordination with implementation and fundraising teams.
  • Oversee planning cycles and ensure timely, quality delivery of science and data outputs across all program areas.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (implementation, communications, fundraising, operations) to ensure integrated delivery and coherent reporting.
  • Identify and manage risks to science and data delivery, proposing mitigation strategies and escalating issues as needed.
  • Support the development of annual workplans, performance targets, and KPIs related to monitoring, evaluation, and learning.

People Management (30%)

  • Manage and support a small team responsible for monitoring, data management, and reporting activities.
  • Manage the team and Specialists, providing direction, performance feedback, and professional development support.
  • Work collaboratively with implementation managers to jointly guide field data collection, aligning the territorial agenda with science and data priorities.
  • Foster a collaborative and accountability-driven team culture, consistent with Rare’s values.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support career development planning for direct reports.
  • Coordinate team capacity needs and support recruitment or onboarding processes as required.
  • Support the professional growth of team members through coaching, structured feedback, and identification of learning opportunities.
  • Coordinate consultants or temporary technical support for specific monitoring and data activities when required.

Budget Management (15%)

  • Manage assigned budgets across grants, ensuring expenditures align with approved plans and donor requirements.
  • Review and approve financial transactions within the science and data workstream, monitoring burn rates and flagging variances.
  • Support forecasting, budget revisions, and financial reporting in collaboration with the finance team.
  • Ensure efficient use of financial resources, identifying efficiencies and reallocations where program needs evolve.
  • Provide budget oversight across data-related consultancies, field monitoring activities, and university partnerships, ensuring compliance with Rare’s financial policies.

Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (15%)

  • Support develop the design, manage, and continuously improve Rare Brasil’s M&E framework, integrating biological, socioeconomic, governance, and community wellbeing indicators.
  • Lead the development and implementation of M&E plans across all program sites in consultation with implementation teams.
  • Oversee data quality assurance processes, including routine checks for completeness, consistency, and timelines
  • Manage data collection tools (household surveys, production data, ecological monitoring, governance assessments), ensuring protocols are adaptive.
  • Coordinate with Rare/FF global teams to align data collection, entry, analysis, and visualization with global standards and protocols.
  • Consolidate monitoring results and support analysis for internal learning, adaptive management, and donor reporting.
  • Help ensure that baseline, follow-up, and end-of-cycle monitoring activities are implemented according to approved plans.

Fisheries Science, Socioeconomic Research & Data Systems (10%)

  • Support the implementation of biophysical monitoring activities, including ecological surveys, species assessments, and fisheries productivity indicators within Marine Extractive Reserves (Resex). Manage the Rare and/or Consulted team in socioeconomic research cycles, including household surveys, livelihood assessments, gender and equity analysis, and governance indicators for artisanal fishing communities.
  • Oversee the architecture and quality of Rare Brasil’s data systems, from field data entry platforms to analytical dashboards and impact reporting tools.
  • Lead data governance: standardization, storage, security, and access protocols for all program data.
  • Identify and implement technology solutions (e.g., ODK, KoBoToolbox, GIS, Power BI) to strengthen data infrastructure.
  • Ensure integration with Rare global platforms and data systems.

Knowledge Management and Representation (5%)

  • Support the documentation and dissemination of lessons learned and best practices in science and data for internal and external audiences.
  • Represent Rare Brasil in scientific forums, technical committees, and policy dialogues related to fisheries science and coastal conservation.
  • Collaborate with Rare’s Global M&E and Science teams to ensure consistent methodologies, metrics, and communications.
  • Contribute to publications, technical reports, and communications products that translate scientific evidence for diverse audiences.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION REQUIRED

  • Master’s degree in marine science, fisheries management, environmental science, ecology, or related field.
  • Minimum 7–10 years of professional experience in conservation science, fisheries research, or program monitoring and evaluation, with at least 3 years in a management or team leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and managing M&E frameworks for conservation or development programs.
  • Experience managing partnerships with universities, research institutions, and government agencies.
  • Proven track record in grant management, workplan development, and delivering measurable results with accountability.
  • Fluency in written and spoken Portuguese; advanced English required.
  • Experience in team leadership, performance management, and organizational coordination.
  • Experience working with artisanal fishing communities or in coastal/marine conservation contexts in Brazil.

TARGETED COMPETENCIES

  • PhD or postgraduate degree in fisheries science, environmental science, or related area.
  • Experience in community-based fisheries management and co-management frameworks in coastal or Amazon contexts.
  • Familiarity with artisanal fishing governance and coastal territory management in the states where Rare Brasil operates (Amapá, Pará).
  • Experience working within or in partnership with international NGOs.
  • Valid Category B driver’s license.
  • Strategic leadership and systems thinking applied to people management, science delivery, and program outcomes.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian coastal conservation policy and fisheries governance, particularly in Amazonian states.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Excellent facilitation, partnership-building, and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  • Analytical capacity for interpreting ecological and social data within political and community contexts.
  • Commitment to inclusion, sustainability, and local empowerment.
  • High emotional intelligence and adaptability in multicultural and field-based settings.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, data tracking systems, and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel across coastal marine states where Rare Brasil operates (30–40% travel).

POSITION TYPE AND EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK

This is a full-time position; typical workdays and hours are Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Occasional extended hours may be required. This position is eligible for Rare’s flexible work and telecommuting policy.

Rare is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Especialista em Arquitetura Soluções | Infra e Telecom - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Desafios estratégicos:

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo.

Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio.

Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps.

Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário.

Atuação de Arquitetura:

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio.

A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA.

Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia.

O que a área te oferece de oportunidade:

  • Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia
  • Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia
  • Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de trabalho:

Híbrido (RJ ou SP)

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia;
  • Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T;
  • Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas;
  • Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes;
  • Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas;
  • Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados;
  • Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos.

Ponto de atenção:

Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação superior em carreiras de tecnologia, como engenharias, ciência da computação, etc;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura, Tecnologia, Telecom, Cloud ou áreas afins.
  • Inglês Avançado/Nativo para leitura, escrita e comunicação;
  • Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções;
  • Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud;
  • Vivência em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios;
  • Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional;
  • Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais;
  • Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos;
  • Domínio em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos;
  • Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas;
  • Expertise em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom;
  • Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Experiência em ambientes multicloud ou arquiteturas híbridas complexas;
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código e automação de plataformas;
  • Vivência em telecom definidos por software (SDN / NFV);
  • Experiência em integração entre ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento em uso de IA em operações de tecnologia (AIOps ou Enterprise AI Solutions Architecture);
  • Experiência anterior em arquitetura de soluções, engenharia ou operações, combinada com visão sistêmica;

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link:

Um propósito que nos une e nos inspira, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e sustentável, a educação e a inclusão financeira.

Responsável por traduzir e implementar o planejamento de desenvolvimento da agência, com base nas diretrizes fornecidas pela Cooperativa em conjunto com o líder imediato.

Fomentar o cooperativismo, os programas sociais, manter participação efetiva na comunidade onde está inserido através das entidades de representação social e comercial, em conjunto com ações estruturadas da assessoria de comunicação e marketing e/ou desenvolvimento cooperativista.

Assegurar o atendimento de qualidade aos associados (foco em engajamento e excelência no atendimento).

Oferecer informações técnicas sobre produtos e serviços, com o objetivo de qualificar o atendimento, apoiar decisões financeiras dos associados e efetivar negociações. Atuar de forma integrada com os GNs e demais áreas da Cooperativa, assegurando uma abordagem consultiva, estratégica e orientada para resultados, observando a necessidade do associado.
  • Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Identificar oportunidades de negócios, aumentando a base de associados. Prospectar novos associados e negócios, conhecendo o ramo de atividade desempenhada pelo associado e seu grau de risco. Realizar visitas para concretizar novos negócios e fortalecer o relacionamento com os associados com uma abordagem estratégica e personalizada.
  • Gestão de Crédito e Cobrança: Acompanhar a carteira de crédito da agência, monitorando situações de inadimplência, limites excedidos (over) e operações em risco. Conduzir ou apoiar negociações mais complexas com associados, buscando soluções sustentáveis e alinhadas às diretrizes da Cooperativa. Atuar de forma preventiva e corretiva, em conjunto com os Gerentes de Negócios e áreas especializadas, visando a saúde financeira da carteira e a mitigação de riscos.
  • Gestão Operacional: Gerir as operações diárias da agência, assegurando eficiência, conformidade com políticas e procedimentos, e adequada gestão de riscos. Acompanhar a dinâmica da agência, incluindo contatos, agendamentos, atuação especializada de cada cargo, qualidade do atendimento e minimização de gargalos. Acionar as áreas especialistas da Sede sempre que necessário, indicando demandas de suporte, treinamento ou orientação para o atingimento dos objetivos planejados. Monitorar as transações financeiras, garantindo a segurança das operações e o controle financeiro da agência.
  • Pessoas e Cultura: Realizar o desenvolvimento da equipe da agência, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e de alta performance. Participar, sempre que possível, dos processos de recrutamento e seleção, bem como garantir uma integração adequada dos novos colaboradores. Conduzir avaliações periódicas (formais e informais), fomentando o desenvolvimento das competências técnicas e comportamentais necessárias para o crescimento individual e coletivo. Identificar e viabilizar ações de capacitação, observando aspectos relacionados à produtividade da equipe. Sempre que necessário, acionar a área de pessoas e Cultura da Cooperativa, a fim de solicitar apoio, ferramentas e ou soluções que o auxilie no desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental dos colaboradores da agência.

Atuar como representante da agência, quando necessário, de acordo com suas responsabilidades legais. Garantir a correta aplicação do código de conduta, normativos sistêmicos e locais.
  • Ouvidoria: Gerenciar as demandas de ouvidoria junto à equipe, assegurando a resolução eficaz das solicitações dos associados. Atuar de forma preventiva para reduzir o volume de reclamações, promovendo melhorias contínuas nos processos e no atendimento.

Esta posição é para atuar em regime presencial, em São Paulo, SP.

Como Safety Assurance Manager, você será responsável por liderar, estruturar e garantir a execução consistente do processo de Safety Assurance, incluindo RAMS e V&V, ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos de Digital Intelligence.

Este é um Banco de Talentos de Professores para a Escola Eleva São Paulo. Nas Escolas Eleva, uma de nossas marcas Inspired no Brasil, temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, brilho nos olhos e, adepto da mentalidade de crescimento. Somos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Se você se identifica com a nossa proposta, se inscreva no nosso Banco de Talentos de Professores e assim que surgir uma oportunidade que tenha a ver com o seu perfil, nós entraremos em contato!

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About the Role

Taktile is building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is already making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

  • Taktile was founded by machine learning and data science veterans with extensive experience building and running production ML in financial services.
  • Our team consists of engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers with a diverse set of backgrounds. Some of us attended top universities such as Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford, and some of us have no degree at all.
  • Our team has accumulated extensive work experience at leading tech companies such as Google, Amazon, and Meta, startups, and the enterprise software sphere.
  • Our backers include Y Combinator, Index Ventures, and stellar angels such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath.
  • We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors and show great traction with scale-ups and large enterprises across the financial services and insurance industry. We are looking to build on this success by growing our sales team, professionalizing our go-to-market, and acquiring more enterprise customers.

That’s where you come in.

As Senior Sales Executive — Enterprise Brazil, you are core to our mission of building and expanding Taktile's enterprise customer base across Brazil's financial services sector. You will play a critical role in driving growth by creating a robust pipeline of strategic accounts among the country's largest banks and financial institutions and guiding them through complex sales cycles with expertise and care.

As a trusted partner and credible brand ambassador, you will represent Taktile in the Brazilian enterprise market, building strong relationships with senior stakeholders across risk, credit, technology, procurement, and legal. You will own deals with annual contract values above R$ 1M, navigate multi-month procurement processes at Tier-1 banks, and define how Taktile is sold, positioned, and delivered in Brazil for years to come. This role reports directly to Carolina Fraidemberge and is a foundational hire for our Brazil team.

About You

  • You’ve met or exceeded your sales targets for 5+ years at $200K+ ACVs.
  • You have extensive experience managing complex deal cycles of 6+ months.
  • You know how to build deep, strategic relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including C-suite executives.
  • You’re curious and customer‑centric, with a talent for understanding enterprise customers’ challenges and delivering solutions tailored to their needs.
  • You’re humble and have a growth mindset, eager to continuously learn, implement new methodologies, and bring best practices into the business.
  • You’re collaborative and thrive in cross‑functional environments, working closely with Marketing, BDR, and Customer Success teams.
  • You’re strategic and creative—always finding innovative ways to engage prospects and enhance the enterprise buying experience.
  • You have exceptional communication skills, with an ability to craft compelling messages that resonate with enterprise stakeholders.
  • You have a proven track record selling SaaS/software subscriptions to Financial Services and/or enterprise‑scale businesses.
  • You are highly skilled in prospecting and navigating complex organizations to identify and engage decision‑makers.

What You’ll Do

  • Sell Taktile’s innovative decisioning software solution to large enterprise customers in Financial Services to meet or exceed your revenue targets.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our enterprise target markets, ideal customer profiles, and competitive landscape.
  • Manage a pipeline of complex, multi‑stakeholder sales opportunities from lead to close, focusing on long‑term value.
  • Drive outbound prospecting efforts to engage and qualify enterprise accounts.
  • Qualify and nurture opportunities generated by BDRs and Marketing.
  • Lead discovery sessions, product demos, and executive presentations to showcase Taktile’s value proposition.
  • Provide a seamless and outstanding buying experience for our enterprise customers.
  • Collaborate with the Customer Success team to ensure smooth handovers and long‑term customer success.
  • Upsell and cross‑sell within enterprise accounts to maximize value for customers and drive revenue growth.
  • Leverage proven enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDICC and Challenger.
  • Use CRM and sales tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc., to manage and track progress.
  • Provide market feedback to Product, Marketing, and Leadership to influence the roadmap and go‑to‑market strategies.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Experience working in an early‑stage start‑up (Seed - Series B).
  • Deep knowledge of the FinTech, data, or ML/AI landscape.

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early‑stage company.
  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.
  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.
  • Receive a top‑of‑market equity and cash compensation package.
  • Get access to a self‑development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.
  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set‑up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.
  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you have experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control.

By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision‑making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve.

Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision‑making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry.

We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast‑growing startups and enterprise leaders.

Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath — we’re building a world‑class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI‑driven decision‑making in financial services.

title: Account Executive I
description:
The Role We Need:

PadSplit is growing rapidly, and we’re expanding our Sales team to meet increasing demand from property owners and real estate investors eager to join our mission. As we continue to scale, we need driven Account Executives who can connect new partners to the PadSplit platform and help unlock more affordable housing opportunities across the country.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We’re seeking a tenacious, optimistic problem-solver who thrives in a dynamic startup environment. The ideal candidate loves sales, cares about helping people, and can blend hustle with high integrity. You’re excited by challenge, passionate about purpose‑driven work, and ready to help PadSplit change the world—one room at a time.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day‑To‑Day:

  • Lead Qualification: Identify and qualify new prospects from a mix of inbound (80%) and outbound (20%) leads.
  • Prospecting & Outreach: Execute high‑volume cold calling, emailing, and social selling to meet monthly KPIs.
  • Sales Execution: Deliver tailored pitches that demonstrate the superior financial and social impact of PadSplit.
  • Presentations & Webinars: Host group presentations for real estate investors to showcase PadSplit’s value proposition.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate deal flow in Salesforce and SalesLoft, ensuring timely follow‑ups.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Ops, Marketing, and Customer Success to create a seamless partner experience.
  • Feedback Loop: Share customer insights to help refine our sales strategy and influence product development.
  • Goal Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Here’s What You’ll Need To Be Successful:

  • Sales Experience: 2+ years in consultative B2B inside sales, with a track record of exceeding goals.
  • Outbound Skills: Proficiency in phone, email, and text‑based prospecting and outreach.
  • CRM Proficiency: Skilled in managing accurate data and workflow within Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar tools.
  • Relationship Building: Strong ability to engage, educate, and influence small to mid‑market clients.
  • Communication: Confident speaking and presenting over video to groups or individuals.
  • Industry Interest: Curiosity and enthusiasm for real estate and the future of housing innovation.
  • Cultural Fit: Embodies PadSplit’s values—compassionate directness, integrity, optimism, curiosity, empathy, and strong work ethic.
  • Bonus Experience: Background in real estate investment or prior success in an early‑stage startup sales role.

The Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Revenue Ops Lead for forty‑five (45) minutes.
  • If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with our Sales Leadership team presenting research from a Case Study.
  • If warranted, then we move to offer!

$20,000 - $42,000 a year

Compensation is based on the role's scope, market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. In addition to the base salary, there is a commission component: The base salary range for an Account Executive I is $20,000-$30,000 USD with a variable commission structure.

Variable: $25 per room expansion

On-Target Variable Commission is 480 rooms/year, or $12,000 in variable compensation.
